Hello Singapore! We are happy to share the new design of our % Arabica Singapore Jewel Changi Airport store. This new and extended space pays homage to Singapore’s Shangri La Hotel Garden Wing, and is inspired by mid-century design. 

Located within Jewel Changi Airport, where a dramatic waterfall cascades through a lush indoor garden, the renewed % ARABICA draws inspiration from its unique surroundings. We have collaborated with the Japanese design studio no.10, and here are the designer’s notes: 

“Retaining ARABICA's signature white and natural wood materials, the design incorporates lush greenery to create a more open and welcoming atmosphere while responding to the mall's design regulations. The existing kitchen counter was expanded to improve functionality, while new merchandise displays were introduced to enrich the retail experience. The former counter stools were replaced with comfortable sofa seating, offering travelers a place to relax, connect, and recharge before or after their journeys. We hope this store becomes a welcoming destination where people from around the world can pause, enjoy a cup of coffee, and share a moment of calm amid their travels.”

-
This is % Singapore store no. 4, our global store no. 240, % ΔRΔBICΔ Singapore Jewel Changi Airport opening today. Please come enjoy our simple passion for coffee, design and #seetheworldthroughcoffee ***

@madisonsonhill.sg x @oldchangkeesingapore have teamed up to reimagine Singapore’s beloved local street food classics into a stunning afternoon tea set.

🥠 Sidewalk Savouries
Chilli Crab Puff – A mandatory nod to Old Chang Kee’s legendary pastry game!
Laksa Prawn with avocado, blinis & laksa leaf – Rich, aromatic, and perfectly balanced.
Satay Chicken Tartelette with puffed rice – Big local flavor in a delicate, crispy bite.
Seaweed Cracker with shredded egg, green mango salad & cincalok – Super refreshing with a punchy zesty kick.
Mini Black Sesame Ball & Vegetable Spring Roll

🥭 Sweet Fun
Nasi Lemak Scone – A mind-bending, savory-sweet spin that somehow just works.
Curry Corn Mousse & Dark Chocolate Chili Canelé – Bold, adventurous fusion done right!
Ondeh Ondeh Mousse & Pulut Hitam Mousse with coconut crunch – Creamy nostalgia in a bite.
Red Bean Mochi Tart, Yuzu Macaron & classic Heritage Almond Cookies.

🏕️🍛 CAMPING + CURRY = THE ULTIMATE COMFORT FOOD! 🤤🔥

Who says you can’t have a delicious bowl of curry while camping? 😍

During my camping trip, I brought along @oldchangkeesingapore Curry Paste and turned it into a super easy and comforting bowl of Curry Ee Mian! 🍜🍛

The best part? So convenient, so flavourful and absolutely delicious! 🤤 No need to pack a whole bunch of curry spices — just bring the curry paste, a few simple ingredients and you’re good to go! ⛺️

👨🏻‍🍳 My Camping Curry Ee Mian

🛒 Ingredients:
• 1 packet Old Chang Kee Curry Paste
• 600ml water
• 500g chicken thighs
• 400g potato cubes
• 150ml evaporated milk
• Ee Mian or rice

🔥 How to cook:
1️⃣ Mix 1 packet of curry paste with 600ml water and bring to a boil.
2️⃣ Add chicken thighs and simmer for 10 mins.
3️⃣ Add potato cubes and simmer for another 15 mins.
4️⃣ Add Ee Mian, stir in 150ml evaporated milk and bring to a gentle boil.
5️⃣ Serve hot and enjoy! 🤤🍛

Perfect for camping, road trips or even a quick meal at home! 🙌🏻
